title: Recording: Zoo Gang by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

‘Zoo Gang’, the b-side of Wings’ 1974 single ‘Band On The Run’ in the United Kingdom, was recorded on 25 April 1973.

It was written as the theme tune of a UK TV drama series, The Zoo Gang, that ran for six episodes in 1974. It was made by Sir Lew Grade’s ATV, who asked Paul McCartney to write the theme.

The backing track was recorded in 15 takes, the last of which was became the master. A jam, titled ‘Zoological Blow’, was also recorded. ‘Zoo Gang’ was completed on 7 May with an accordion overdub.

Denny Laine and Henry McCullough did not attend the session, which featured Paul and Linda McCartney and drummer Denny Seiwell.
